svg.title: Test five heating and cooling cycles
svg.desc: Conceptual stage diagram. Five cycles between source endpoints; arrows do not establish initial endpoint or dwell times.
svg.text: Test five heating and cooling cycles
Repeatedly heat to 0 °C and cool to −30 °C five times and
measure fluorescence. Ramp rates, hold times per cycle and
the chronological initial endpoint are not specified. Do not
assign the general 12 h characterization hold to each cycle.
